transport: Private mode-0700 per-run file spool; exclusive temp writes, file fsync, atomic rename, directory fsync
durability_order: Wrapper registration published before waiting for ACK
Runner validates and retains exact group in durable custody journal
Only after journal fsync, runner publishes exact hash-bound ACK
Only after full ACK/deadline/identity validation, wrapper may Popen native child
Wrapper publishes child identity before output processing; exact wait and completion follow
Runner accepts completion before exit grant; custody ends only after group absence observation
failure_rules: No ACK, invalid binding, closed launch latch or expired deadline means no native Popen
Late valid requests remain cleanup-owned but receive no launch ACK
Bootstrap/prepublication uncertainty fails and preserves scratch; it does not authorize a guessed group kill
Lost leader identity with a live group fails and preserves scratch rather than risking a reused group
All known groups must be absent and waits complete before scratch removal
Hard kill/uninterruptible creation or I/O is an explicit completion limit, not a clean receipt
